pass_a_gloss: Second brother: King of world raises; alastor warned.
pass_b_english: The second, his skin with the hair torn off, cried with his last breath: 'Thou, miscreant, releasest us from this present life; but the King of the world shall raise us, who died for his laws, unto eternal reviving of life.' (2 Maccabees 7:7–9) Avenging spirit, learn that tortures loose the body but bind the tortured unto judgment.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Exhortatio exists; nothing to compare.
